definitions.full: H2260. chibbel חִבֵּל noun [masculine] probably mast (as corded or roped in place; denominative from חֶבֶל ) — only in simile of drunken man ח בְּראֹשׁ ׳שֹׁכֵב Prov 23:24 (opposed to בְּלֶביָֿם שֹׁכֵב ) i.e. in the lookout-basket at the mast-head, compare Thes in carchesio. — ᵑ9 ᵐ5 read חֹבֵל .
definitions.rootNote: from 2254 (in the sense of furnished with ropes);
